targets.note: The mic at rest beside the box: one size in every state.
Pressed: the four level bars move and the words land in the box as they are heard, the last part still changing.
A member in a team Space with no key: the mic is dimmed and a press says Voice isn't set up. Ask an admin to add a key.
An admin in the same state gets the same line and the link Add a key in Console.
